lines.text: Find a comfortable position, ... and gently close your eyes.
Take a slow, ... deep breath in... and let it go.
Let your body soften, ... and your mind grow still.
Just breathe, ... in this stillness, ... for a moment longer.
You are safe here. You are ready to begin.
Now picture the front door of your own home. ... See its colour, ... its handle, ... the way it opens.
This home is your memory palace. ... Every place in it can hold something for you.
We will walk the same path every time, ... so your mind always knows the way.
Make each object big, ... bright, ... and a little unusual. ... Strange pictures stay in the mind.
Leave it there, ... and walk on.
Now go back to your front door. ... Walk the same path again, ... slowly.
At each place, ... look around. ... What did you leave there?
Open your eyes when you are ready, ... and show what you found.
Before you finish today, ... close your eyes once more ... and walk through your palace.
Your palace is always with you. ... The more you walk it, ... the stronger it becomes.
When you are ready, ... gently open your eyes.
Welcome back. ... Before today's practice, ... walk through yesterday's palace. ... What is still waiting at each place?
You are at the front door.
Step into the hallway.
Walk into the living room.
Go into the kitchen.
Enter your bedroom.
Now step into the bathroom.
Walk out onto the balcony.
Sit down at your study table.
Go to the dining table.
Stop at the window.
A giant mango, ... glowing gold.
A red umbrella, ... dripping wet.
A steel kettle, ... whistling loudly.
An alarm clock, ... ringing and jumping.
A huge bunch of keys, ... jingling.
A tall stack of warm rotis.
A bright green parrot, ... talking.
A candle taller than you.
A basket of eggs, ... wobbling.
A mobile phone, ... buzzing and buzzing.
A tiny elephant, ... wearing shoes.
An auto-rickshaw, ... full of flowers.
A rainbow-coloured kite.
A block of ice, ... melting fast.
A sunflower, ... as tall as a tree.
A train whistle, ... blowing.
A paper boat, ... floating in a bucket.
A mountain of salt.
A camel, ... drinking from a cup.
A golden bicycle.
A book, ... flapping like a bird.
A pencil, ... as long as a broom.
A globe, ... spinning fast.
A blackboard, ... covered in stars.
A calculator, ... singing a song.
A school bag, ... full of oranges.
A ruler, ... made of chocolate.
A laptop, ... glowing blue.
A trophy, ... filled with water.
A pair of glasses, ... on a cat.
A drum, ... beating by itself.
A flute, ... made of sugarcane.
A diya, ... with three bright flames.
A heavy garland, ... of orange marigolds.
A kite string, ... tangled everywhere.
A bell, ... ringing inside a box.
A colourful rangoli, ... that moves.
A spinning top, ... as big as a chair.
A box of sweets, ... overflowing.
A peacock, ... dancing.
